dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even though Naku Weed has a flower-like structure, its "petals" are in fact leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Its actual bloom is rather fragile, so the surrounding leaves try their hardest to grow strong and protect it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, just like Paimon is protecting you right now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just like you? Oh, is Naku Weed edible too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right! ...Wait? What are you trying to say?
